frozen_estimator_constants.perturb_noise_law: standard normal, drawn up front from a seeded CPU torch.Generator per call (through_m._perturbed_clearing)
frozen_estimator_constants.st_mask_rule: identity on engine-cleared coordinates (allocation > 0), zero elsewhere
frozen_estimator_constants.pam_mask_rule: identity on perturbed-MAP-selected coordinates, zero elsewhere
frozen_estimator_constants.rng_tree: train_kernel = index 3 of ('data','init','minibatch','train_kernel'); TrainKernelStream walks children spawn_key=(3, k), k = call index, each split into (engine draw seed, PAM noise seed); estimator-blind advancement
frozen_estimator_constants.provenance: constants are imported from the frozen ecomd/mechanisms/through_m.py (sha256 fb50bb4f1baec856001a1da31b9bdc6242669bfd49effdabb7fa374a665dc179 at build time) — the wrapper adds no new tunable

public_api.engine_bridge: engine_execute_level(quantities, demand, *, level_price, kernel, engine_seed=0, rng_state=None) -> LevelOutcome (pure forward; quantities int-or-float dtype, integer-valued, CPU)
public_api.st_estimator: straight_through_level(quantities, demand, *, level_price, kernel, engine_seed=0, rng_state=None) -> LevelOutcome (float dtype required; forward = engine output; backward = through_m._StraightThrough at PINNED_STRAIGHT_THROUGH_SCALE)
public_api.pam_estimator: perturb_and_map_level(quantities, demand, *, level_price, kernel, pam_seed, engine_seed=0, rng_state=None) -> LevelOutcome (forward = engine output; backward = through_m._PerturbAndMap masked by through_m._perturbed_clearing at PINNED_PERTURB_AND_MAP_SIGMA)
public_api.hooks: straight_through_hook(*, kernel, stream=None, seed_root=None) / perturb_and_map_hook(*, kernel, stream=None, seed_root=None) -> MechanismEstimator (exact frozen Callable[[Tensor, int], Tensor] shape; kernel-blind inputs; engine at NOMINAL_LEVEL_PRICE=1)
public_api.rng: train_kernel_substream_seed(seed_root, *tail) (equals E-2 named_substream_seed(root,'train_kernel') at tail=()); TrainKernelStream(seed_root).next_call_seeds() -> (engine_seed, pam_seed), estimator-blind one-child-per-call advancement
public_api.outcome: LevelOutcome(allocation, allocation_exact, filled_mask, fills, resting_after, channels_delta (2,) int64 (volume_units, cash_ticks), executed_units, cash_delta, inventory_delta, post_rng_state, post_aggregate_digest, engine_tape)
public_api.composition: compose_round(state: BridgeState | None, outcome) -> BridgeState(channels int64 (2,), resting) — integer-exact threading of post-round anonymous state + conserving channels to the next input

test_engine_bridge_byte_determinism - byte-identical tapes/allocations/digests/RNG state across identical calls; rng_state injection pins the draw stream

spec_deviations.deviation: Bridge granularity is one touched price level per call, not one whole round/book
spec_deviations.resolution: engine_execute_level builds a synthetic single-level lab-asset-v3 session (one resting ask per nonzero slot at level_price in slot order, buyer aggressor AGG, slack endowments) and submits exactly one marketable order through ReferenceEngine.submit; multi-level rounds compose by per-level calls threading rng_state
spec_deviations.reason: The hook signature is frozen in fact_surrogate.MechanismEstimator ('resting quantities of one touched level') and through_m's pool semantics are within-price; this is the narrower, more deterministic reading of 'intercept a predicted round-t flow tensor'

spec_deviations.deviation: Aggressor side fixed to BUY in the synthetic session
spec_deviations.resolution: WLOG pin; within-level fills, allocations and channels are side-symmetric
spec_deviations.reason: conservative determinism; no information in the within-level kernel depends on side

spec_deviations.deviation: Post-round anonymous state returned as the per-slot resting grid (resting_after int64) + conserving channels + engine state fingerprints, not a full book tensor
spec_deviations.resolution: LevelOutcome carries resting_after, channels_delta, post_rng_state, post_aggregate_digest, engine_tape; compose_round threads BridgeState(channels, resting)
spec_deviations.reason: the bridge session is single-level by construction, so a full book tensor would be fabricated state; next-round model inputs remain the corpus adapter's (E-1/L1-1) responsibility

spec_deviations.deviation: Estimator backwards consumed via same-package imports of through_m private members (_StraightThrough/_PerturbAndMap/_perturbed_clearing) instead of the public wrapper functions
spec_deviations.resolution: straight_through_through_m/perturb_and_map_through_m are NOT used for the forward because their forward is the pure clearing simulator, not the engine; the wrapper composes engine forward + through_m autograd Functions so the backward Jacobians have a single source of truth
spec_deviations.reason: E-3's forward must be ReferenceEngine.submit's output (spec); re-implementing the Jacobians would create drift risk the spec explicitly forbids

spec_deviations.deviation: PAM noise=0 equivalence is asserted on the deterministic (fifo) arm and the single-maker collapse stratum; on multi-maker random-unit pools sigma=0 PAM equals the kernel-fixed depleting-argmax MAP rule, not the draw-realized allocation
spec_deviations.resolution: gate test asserts exact equality where the reduction holds and hand-computed MAP self-consistency where it does not (documented in-test)
spec_deviations.reason: matches the estimator menu's own 'on deterministic arms' scoping (prereg v2 section 5.2); engine draws are not the MAP rule, so claiming full-kernel equality would be an overclaim

spec_deviations.deviation: Hooks execute the engine at a nominal level price of 1
spec_deviations.resolution: NOMINAL_LEVEL_PRICE=1; within-level allocations are price-invariant; the model composes cash at true prices via allocation x slot_prices (fact_surrogate) or callers use the level functions with the real level_price
spec_deviations.reason: the frozen hook signature carries no price; the conserving cash channel is composed at true prices by the model side, keeping the hook kernel- AND price-blind

spec_deviations.deviation: Tape-level byte-exactness gate uses the lab-asset replay validator on the frozen fixtures (G6's own wording), with the wrapper-mediated claim being fill-by-fill round reproduction
spec_deviations.resolution: both asserted: replay() ok + explicit four-hash/record_to_json equality per record, AND bridge fill-by-fill equality with RNG threading through the wrapper's own entry point
spec_deviations.reason: the post-D0 G6 probe (through-M on the DGP's realized request stream) composes these instruments; pre-D0 CPU scope cannot run the DGP stream

spec_deviations.deviation: lab_asset imports are function-level (lazy) inside the wrapper, with a guarded sys.path bootstrap at bridge-call time
spec_deviations.resolution: importing ecomd.mechanisms.through_m_wrapper never touches sys.path; the first engine_execute_level call inserts REPO_ROOT/scripts into sys.path if absent (the in-repo idiom of scripts/lab_asset/dgp_request_generator.py), so training-side hook callers need no path setup; mypy runs with MYPYPATH=scripts for full typing
spec_deviations.reason: keeps ecomd import-time clean in any context while the bridge still targets the exact engine from ecomd training loops (L2-2)

spec_deviations.deviation: Validation surface: demand >= 1, level_price >= 1, seeds >= 0, autograd entry points require floating dtype; zero-quantity slots rest no orders (E-1 never-clearable padding contract)
spec_deviations.reason: conservative fail-loud contracts mirroring through_m's own validation

interface_notes: L2-2 attaches directly: straight_through_hook/perturb_and_map_hook return exact MechanismEstimator callables (signature (quantities, demand)); proven by test_hooks_attach_to_recurrent_fact_surrogate producing integer-lattice mechanism_channels with gradients reaching the heads.

TrainKernelStream is the C2-note-3 'one seed-spawned stream replayed across all through-M arms within a seed': estimator-blind, one child per mechanism call, split into (engine draw seed, PAM noise seed); derivation cross-checked against E-2's named_substream_seed in tests.

For random_unit_within_price with tape reproduction, pass rng_state = the fixture/engine RNG state captured before the request and thread LevelOutcome.post_rng_state level-to-level; the engine RNG state is bound into every record's state hash, so byte-exact fill reproduction certifies the draw stream matched.

LevelOutcome.cash_delta/inventory_delta are the engine's integer-exact zero-sum settlement deltas over the synthetic session's actors (AGG + makers) — the audit surface for conservation; CHANNEL_ORDER matches E-4's ('volume_units','cash_ticks').
quantities may be int64 for engine_execute_level (pure forward) but must be floating for the autograd entry points (torch requirement, fail-loud enforced).

The pre-existing mypy diagnostics in tests/test_through_m_estimators.py (imported for load_arm/_dispatch/_crossed_level_snapshots/_kernel_for) belong to the earlier estimator item and were not touched.
